subject.title: fix(maint): reuse recent same-PR hosted gates

question: Should hosted gates ever be reusable across different code revisions of the same PR without patch-equivalence proof?
rationale: The PR intentionally exchanges exact-code verification for faster landing, so the owner must either preserve the existing identity guarantee or explicitly accept the weaker automation boundary.

options.title: Require code equivalence
options.body: Reuse older gates only when the earlier and current heads have the same verified PR patch or tree.

options.title: Accept same-PR reuse
options.body: Permit different revisions of one PR to share recent hosted evidence while current-head checks are pending.

recommendation.title: Require code equivalence
recommendation.body: Reuse older gates only when the earlier and current heads have the same verified PR patch or tree.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the existing reuse policy, authored this expansion, and is the current assignee.
